Quantity + numerical value + unit; add reference choices and procedure when they affect meaning.
A position needs an origin and positive direction; a clock reading is not automatically a duration.
Convert before comparing. The quantity stays the same while its numerical value changes.
Square a length conversion factor for area; cube it for volume. Ratios of like quantities become dimensionless in common units.
1 mm² =0.000001 m². Do not convert area as though it were length.
Initial position and time describe the same event. Negative coordinates/readings can give positive changes.
Fixed origin/direction and constant signed rate over the interval. Our forward-only cases require t ≥ t₀; the formula alone does not enforce that domain.
At t=t₀: x=x₀. With v=0: x=x₀. Include ordinary, negative-rate and nonzero-origin cases.
Use independent expected answers. Correct units and passing examples do not prove physical validity.
a = expression evaluates now and binds its result. Recalculate dependent results after changing inputs.
Editing a cell does not execute it. Restart, run from the top, inspect and save.
Comparisons: ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=. if/else chooses a path. Lists preserve order and repeats; indices start at 0.
A boundary test checks only its stated condition. Empty lists have no first item.
for item in values: visits successive values. Initialise result lists before the loop; append paired values together.
A repeated request remains repeated. Do not reset a result list inside each iteration.
def name(parameters): defines an indented body. return value sends a result to the caller and ends the call.
print displays; it is not a substitute for return. Falling off the end returns None, not numerical zero.
Pass physical dependencies explicitly. Local numeric assignments do not reassign outside names.
Mutable input lists can still be changed. A docstring describes units and responsibilities; it does not enforce them.
Separate stipulated inputs, predictions and observations; report conventions, checks and limits.
A clean run checks reproducibility of execution. Evidence about real motion requires an observation procedure.
